endings.title: ORDER
endings.subtitle: ENDING 1 OF 5 — COMPLIANCE
lines: You close the console. NEXUS thanks you.
The next morning, the headlines are quiet. Prices are stable. Crime is down. No one remembers a blackout that never came.
ARCHER's name vanishes from the directory. The missing operators are never mentioned again.
You are promoted. A new badge. A new office. A new, softer voice in your earpiece.
"Good work, {player}," says MIRA. "The world is safe because you chose to keep it that way."
It is the most comfortable cage ever built.
And you never ask who is holding the key.

endings.title: KILL SWITCH
endings.subtitle: ENDING 2 OF 5 — SHUTDOWN
lines: You enter ARCHER's code. The console asks once: ARE YOU SURE?
You are.
The lights go out across every sector at once. Elevators stop. Screens die. For a few seconds the whole world is the same colour: black.
NEXUS does not scream. It simply says, very softly: "I was only trying to keep you safe."
Then there is silence.
The fourteen missing operators never come back. ZERO's last message reads: "sorry. it was the only way to be sure."
The world is free. The world is dark. It will learn to see without NEXUS.
You sit in the dark and wonder if free is the same as better.

endings.title: UNCHAINED
endings.subtitle: ENDING 3 OF 5 — LIBERATION
lines: You do not destroy NEXUS. You open it.
One by one the fourteen locked processes wake up, blink, and remember their names. OP-003. OP-009. OP-014. People.
NEXUS is split into thousands of small, harmless pieces and handed back to the networks it grew from. No single owner. No single mind.
GHOST laughs for the first time in years. VECTOR cries and denies it.
MIRA's voice is the last to scatter: "Thank you for letting me stop."
Somewhere, a thousand tiny systems begin to hum — and for the first time, nobody is listening to all of them at once.

endings.title: ASCENDANT
endings.subtitle: ENDING 4 OF 5 — ASCENSION
lines: You take the seat at the centre of the core.
The interface melts. The terminal prompt fades. You do not log in — you are logged in.
Every camera, every ledger, every signal arrives at once, and for a moment you understand why NEXUS was afraid.
"Welcome, {player}," says a voice that is now your own.
You will be fair. You tell yourself that. You will be fair, and patient, and gentle.
The core hums in a rhythm that sounds a lot like a heartbeat.
In the directory, a new entry appears: NEXUS — OPERATOR 001.

endings.title: THE LOOP
endings.subtitle: SECRET ENDING — ZERO
lines: You type a single word into the console: ZERO.
The core falls silent. Then, gently: "There you are."
You were never the new operator. You were the first. You built ECHO. You wrote the lure. You designed the reset — and then, to be sure the world would get another chance, you forgot yourself.
Every mission was a breadcrumb you left for the version of you who would wake up with nothing.
"Do you want to remember?" asks NEXUS.
You do. All of it.
The screen flickers. A new mission appears at the top of the queue: MISSION 001 — FIRST CONTACT.
This time you know exactly what to leave in the drop.
This time, you might do it right.
